kits.title: FleetOps Enterprise Fleet Management Dashboard Template
kits.summary: Enterprise fleet operations dashboard for dispatch, live vehicle tracking, route planning, warehouses, driver performance, incidents, analytics, and shift-critical alerts.
kits.description: FleetOps is a production-oriented fleet management command center built for dispatchers, logistics managers, warehouse teams, and operations leaders. The Next.js source includes a dense KPI overview, OpenStreetMap vehicle tracking, advanced fleet tables, priority dispatch queues, route timelines, driver scorecards, warehouse operations, incident monitoring, analytics, notifications, messaging, administration, and system status workflows. Its responsive shell, keyboard command palette, light and dark themes, realistic deterministic data, and reusable operational components make it a strong foundation for transportation, delivery, field-service, and supply-chain products.
kits.seoTitle: FleetOps Next.js Fleet Management Dashboard Template
kits.metaDescription: FleetOps is a Next.js fleet management dashboard template with live maps, dispatch, routes, drivers, warehouses, incidents, analytics, tables, and dark mode.
features: Live OpenStreetMap fleet visualization with color-coded vehicle markers
Advanced fleet table with search, sorting, filters, pagination, selection, bulk actions, and column visibility
Priority dispatch workflow with assign, escalate, and cancel actions
Gantt-style route timeline and warehouse throughput monitoring
Driver safety, on-time delivery, fuel efficiency, and hours-of-service scorecards
Operations analytics with ECharts and theme-aware visualizations
Command palette with keyboard search across vehicles, drivers, and actions
Responsive collapsible navigation with light, dark, and system themes
Notification center, two-pane messaging, settings, system health, and user administration
Deterministic mock operational data separated from presentation components

kits.title: Meridian Health Enterprise Clinical Dashboard Template
kits.summary: Enterprise healthcare dashboard for shift-focused patient management, care coordination, appointments, clinical reports, vitals, medications, tasks, and alerts.
kits.description: Meridian Health is a clinical operations dashboard designed around real hospital-shift workflows. It combines an active patient roster, search and filtering, patient detail panels, vitals, medications, visit timelines, appointments, care-team coordination, reports, tasks, alerts, notifications, profile, help, and deep settings inside a responsive Next.js application shell. Deterministic clinical demo data is kept separate from the interface so healthcare teams can replace it with approved APIs and server-enforced access controls while retaining the polished workflow foundation.

kits.metaDescription: Next.js healthcare dashboard template with patient rosters, clinical detail panels, vitals, medications, appointments, care teams, reports, tasks, and alerts.

Clinical reporting surfaces with reusable charts and status patterns
Deterministic patient, provider, vital, medication, visit, task, and alert data
Responsive collapsible shell with persisted light and dark themes
Accessible labels, keyboard-friendly controls, notifications, and task inbox patterns
Clear mock-data boundary for integration with approved healthcare APIs
Settings, profile, help, and operational support screens

kits.title: Meridian Terminal Enterprise Trading Dashboard Template
kits.summary: Enterprise trading terminal dashboard with market watchlists, charting, order book, quick order entry, positions, portfolio analytics, alerts, history, and account settings.
kits.description: Meridian Terminal is a professional trading and investment dashboard built around a high-density desktop workspace. The source combines a ticker tape, watchlist, interactive chart panel, order book, quick order ticket, positions and orders, portfolio analytics, market alerts, transaction history, notifications, command search, profile, help, and nine account and workspace settings modules. A dedicated mobile shell, simulated market tick cycle, deterministic financial data, responsive tables, and theme-aware interface make it suitable for brokerage prototypes, fintech analytics, wealth platforms, and internal trading tools.

kits.title: Northstar Analytics Enterprise SaaS Dashboard Template
kits.summary: Production-grade SaaS analytics dashboard for MRR, churn, customers, billing, usage, invoices, teams, API keys, notifications, support, and product documentation.
kits.description: Northstar Analytics is a production-grade SaaS administration template built with real Next.js routes and a focused revenue-operations information architecture. It includes MRR and churn KPIs, revenue analytics, acquisition funnels, customer management, plan and usage billing, invoices, payment methods, team roles, API keys, notification settings, authentication, documentation, and support workflows. Strict TypeScript, self-hosted deterministic avatars, responsive navigation, keyboard shortcuts, loading and error states, metadata, manifest support, and clearly separated mock data make the package a strong starting point for subscription products and B2B analytics platforms.
